iep_goals.description: Given a grade 4 passage and a graphic organizer for text clues, Doc will answer inferential questions with 80% accuracy across 3 consecutive weekly probes.
Given two-step word problems at grade 4-5 level, Doc will identify the operation(s) and solve with 80% accuracy across 3 consecutive probes.
During structured peer activities, Doc will start a conversation and keep it going for at least 3 turns in 4 of 5 opportunities across 3 sessions.

Using his visual schedule and break card, Doc will stay in his assigned area or travel with the group during transitions, reducing leaving without permission to 1 or fewer times per day for 4 consecutive weeks.
When showing early signs of frustration (covering ears, pacing), Doc will request a break with his break card or words in 80% of observed opportunities for 4 consecutive weeks.

present_levels: Reading: Decodes grade 4 text accurately (98% word accuracy). Answers literal questions 85% and inferential questions 40% on grade 4 passages (3 probes, Aug 2026).
Math: Multi-digit computation 85% accuracy. Two-step word problems 50% accuracy; tends to compute with every number in the problem.
Written expression: Writes a 3-sentence paragraph with a visual organizer; without one, writes one sentence on topic.
Communication: Initiates a conversation with a peer in 1 of 5 structured opportunities; keeps a topic for 1-2 turns. Speech is intelligible; prosody is flat and loud in noisy settings.

Behavior social emotional: ABC data (2 weeks, Aug 2026): leaves his assigned area without permission an average of 6 times a day, mostly during transitions and in noisy settings; returns with one verbal prompt in most cases.
Adaptive: Independent with arrival and unpacking routines. Covers his ears in the cafeteria and gym and uses headphones when offered.
accommodations: Visual schedule reviewed at the start of each day and before changes
Noise-reducing headphones available in cafeteria, gym and assemblies
Break card with a designated break area
Graphic organizers for reading and writing
BCBA consultation with classroom staff on BIP implementation (60 min/month)
Georgia Milestones Grade 5 ELA, Mathematics, Science
services: Specialized instruction: 1500 min x 1/week (Room 104 (special education classroom))
iep.behavior_plan: Behavior plan targets: Leaving assigned area
